method.board: Raspberry Pi 3 Model B Plus Rev 1.3
method.measurement_mode: wall time through production clock_gettime; no PMU or individual-operation quantiles
method.service_placement: Reuse prepare --pmu only for CPU2 service wrappers; measure without --pmu. Caller CPU0; cross-core IPC peer CPU1; temperature read on CPU3 between runs.
method.limits: Report every sample and failure. Two runs within one boot do not count as independent cold boots. Protocol success is not a performance budget, a Linux comparison or a sustained-tail guarantee.

pairing.pairing: Controlled comparison, as in the existing Pi performance experiment: byte-identical user archive, services and probe; production ABI and user sources unchanged between kernel revisions. Each kernel and its symbols retain their own build identity.
